Docket.//PublicMcpUrl: The plane's public MCP endpoint a worker dials; docketd wraps it plus the minted worker token into the harness's --mcp-config at dispatch (§13). Override via DOCKET_PUBLIC_MCP_URL. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:5000. This is also the OAuth 2.1 canonical resource id / issuer (§5): set it to the real public https URL in production.

Operator.//PassphraseHash: SHA-256 hex of the operator passphrase that gates /oauth/authorize (§5). Store the HASH, never the plaintext. When unset the authorize endpoint is fail-closed (503). Generate e.g. with: printf '%s' 'your-passphrase' | shasum -a 256.

Oauth.//AllowInsecureClientMetadata: DEV/TEST ONLY. When true, the CIMD fetcher accepts http and private/loopback client_id hosts, disabling the SSRF address fence. Never enable in production. Default false.
